The '''Berchest system''' was located in the [[Anthos sector/Legends|Anthos sector]], part of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Berchest/Legends|Berchest]].
